versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update: v2 adds comprehensive benchmarking, comparison, and CI support.

- New performance benchmarking, correctness checks, and documentation quality scoring.
- Added commands for benchmarking, report generation, skill comparison, and self-test.
- Outputs results in JSON; integrates easily with CI workflows.
- Zero dependencies; works cross-platform with just Python stdlib.
- Improved documentation and usage examples.
